title: InstallationStatusChangedPayload
description: Payload of the InstallationStatusChanged event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The registered entity the installation belongs to, when the installation is entity-scoped.

installationRef.description: The installation reference, when the installation is not entity-scoped.

status.description: Whether the condition was raised or cleared.

cause.description: Free-text cause of the raise or clear.
